question: A region of space has a uniform magnetic field of flux density $B = 4\pi \times 10^{-4} \text{ T}$. If a material is placed in this field and the magnetic intensity is calculated to be $H = 2 \times 10^2 \text{ A/m}$, calculate the relative magnetic permeability $\mu_r$ of the medium.
